application.name: Production Department Dashboard - Spool Ageing vs. Target

comment: This pipeline reuses config/settings.json's paths.upload_folder and input_files (fabrication/planning/line_history) - see src/production/reader.py. It reads the SAME DPR / Weekly Production Planning / Line History Sheet workbooks already synced into data/upload/projects/ by scripts/sync_drive.py for the Projects dashboard; nothing new needs to be uploaded or synced for this dashboard. data/upload/production/ remains reserved for future Production-only charts that need their own source workbooks - see its README.txt.

publishing.comment: When true, every run also copies production_data.json into paths.website_data_folder - the file website/production.html auto-loads for every visitor of the hosted site, same pattern as config/packing_settings.json.
